screens.name: Terrain cross-section scene (3D map canvas, floating toolbar, overlays)
screens.purpose: Let an operational user click a multi-point path onto Esri 3D terrain, sample an ArcGIS World Elevation profile along it, and hand off to the analysis panels, Save dialog or Aerial capture.
roles: (gate: RoleRoute roles=OPERATIONAL_ROLE_NAMES at web/src/App.tsx:119-126, defined in web/src/utils/roleModel.ts:17-24; MAINTENANCE_FIELD_WORKER/MAINTENANCE are excluded; the nav entry is only pushed when isOperationalUser at web/src/ui/AppShell.tsx:90-92; there is no per-role gating inside the feature files - every operational role sees every button)
primaryTasks: Place two or more control points on the terrain and build (sample) an elevation profile
Open the Profile / Stats / Points / Setup side panels to inspect the result
Save the cross section to a Project, or export a north-up aerial JPEG

responsive.layout: AppShell 'workspace' mode: min-h-screen, lg:h-screen lg:overflow-hidden shell with the nav as a card above the content below lg and a sticky w-64/w-16 column at lg+ (AppShell.tsx:138, 163-185). The workspace root is relative overflow-hidden h-full min-h-[620px] (or fixed inset-0 z-[100] h-[100dvh] in focus mode) with every control absolutely positioned over the SceneView: toolbar left-14 top-3 max-w-[calc(100%-360px)], right rail right-3 top-1/2, aside panel right-20 top-16 bottom-3 with width min(720px|360px, calc(100%-6rem)), basemap pill bottom-3 left-3, legend bottom-14 left-3 w-64, scale bar bottom-3 right-3, status pill bottom-3 left-1/2.
breakpointsUsed: None inside TerrainCrossSectionWorkspace.tsx - no sm/md/lg classes; layout is purely absolute + calc()
sm:grid-cols-4 on the chart hover-field grid (CrossSectionProfileChart.tsx:82) and on the slice stats grid (TerrainSlice3D.tsx:623)
AppShell: lg:hidden / lg:block nav, lg:flex-row, md:px-6 (AppShell.tsx:163-166)

Fixed pixel values: min-h-[620px] (594-596), max-w-[calc(100%-360px)] (600), w-[min(720px,...)] / w-[min(360px,...)] (713-715), w-64 legend (954), min-w-[520px] chart SVG (ProfileChart:104), h-[430px] slice scene (TerrainSlice3D:424, 603), left-[17.5rem] hint offset (991)
phoneRisks: Toolbar max-w-[calc(100%-360px)] computes to <= 0 at 375px (content width 343px), so the nine flex-wrap buttons stack one per row overflowing a 12px-wide dark box that overlaps the drawing hint and the Esri Home/Compass widgets - the primary controls are effectively broken (TerrainCrossSectionWorkspace.tsx:600-601)

The map is a 620px-tall box inside a scrolling page (min-h-[620px], 596); SceneView captures touch for pan/tilt so scrolling past it is a classic map trap, and Full screen (the fix) lives in the broken toolbar

Aside panel becomes 279px wide (calc(100%-6rem)) at right-20, covering the map; the grid-cols-4 metric row squeezes to ~65px cells and the chart SVG min-w-[520px] forces horizontal scroll inside the panel (713-715, 760, ProfileChart:101-104)
Bottom row collides: basemap pill (left), the centred 'Elevation analysis' pill (~330px of text) and the scale bar (right) overlap at 375px (940-951, 975-983, SceneDualScaleBar.tsx:8)
Touch targets ~30-32px: toolbar px-3 py-2 text-xs, rail min-w-16 py-2, close button h-8 w-8, basemap pill py-2 text-[11px] (606, 1051, 730, 946)
Hover-only affordances: crosshair cursor, title tooltips on Clear/DEM coverage/Full screen, chart hover readout via onPointerMove (420, 663, 676, 686; ProfileChart:107)
Esri Search widget (default ~240px) at top-right occupies most of the top edge alongside the toolbar (280)
tabletRisks: 768px portrait: content width 720px minus 360 leaves a 360px toolbar, so buttons wrap to three rows that overlap the 'Click terrain to place' hint at top-16 (600, 698-703)

1024px landscape (lg): the w-64 nav appears so the workspace is ~704px wide; toolbar max-w is 344px (still 3 rows) and the wide Profile panel is 608px at right-20, hiding almost all of the map that goTo() just zoomed to (546, 713-715)

Below lg the workspace does not fill the viewport (h-full of an auto parent = 620px) so a 1024px-tall tablet shows a short map with page scroll; only at lg+ does lg:h-screen kick in (AppShell.tsx:138)

Slice tab: a 430px ArcGIS SceneView with wheel/touch zoom sits inside an overflow-y-auto aside, creating a scroll trap when the user tries to reach the stats below it (TerrainSlice3D.tsx:424, 439; Workspace:713)
desktopNotes: The toolbar only fits on one row when the workspace is >= ~1040px wide (viewport >= ~1360px with the expanded nav); on a 1280px laptop it wraps to two rows
The Profile panel (720px) plus rail (right-20) leaves roughly half the map visible at 1440px; the map auto-zooms to the profile extent behind the panel (546)
Hover linkage between chart and 3D marker works well with a mouse; keyboard users have no equivalent
Overlay chrome is hard-coded dark (bg-[#0f172a], slate-950, white/20) while the aside uses theme tokens, so Light/Coastal themes get a mixed look (594, 601, 705 vs 713)

painPoints.issue: Toolbar width calc breaks below ~1360px viewport and collapses completely on phones
painPoints.evidence: TerrainCrossSectionWorkspace.tsx:600 max-w-[calc(100%-360px)] with flex-wrap at 601; no breakpoint fallback

painPoints.issue: Only 'Undo last point' exists: no drag, delete or reorder of an individual control point, and the Points panel is read-only
'+ New' and 'Clear' wipe the path, profile and saved-state with no confirmation; 'Add points' silently discards the built profile
Saved cross sections cannot be reopened: the API exposes getSavedCrossSection/listProjectCrossSections but no screen calls them, and the 'Saved to' state dies on New/Clear/navigation

Same facts shown up to five times: Path/Samples/Spacing/Source coverage in the panel subtitle, metric row, DEM block, Stats panel, Setup card and bottom pill; demQualityNote rendered twice; Min/Max/Gain/Loss in two panels

Esri-internal vocabulary leaks into user copy: 'Terrain3D', 'Data Extents catalog', 'PixelSize footprint', 'finest-contiguous'; long caveat paragraphs are shown by default rather than behind a disclosure
One toolbar mixes five button treatments (brand, ghost, white/10 bordered, emerald, sky, red text) with no hierarchy rule
Basemap switch exists twice (bottom-left pill and Setup panel) and the Profile panel can be opened from three places (rail, bottom pill, auto-open)
Verb inconsistency for the same action: 'Build profile', 'Finish & profile', 'Rebuild', 'Sampling…', 'Sample profile to resolve', 'Build profile to sample the DEM'
Rail labels do not match panel titles: Stats -> 'Cross-section statistics', Setup -> 'Cross-section setup', Points -> 'Control points', Profile -> 'Elevation analysis'
Disabled state relies on opacity-35/50 over a translucent dark bar; the resulting text contrast is far below 4.5:1
Legend footnote at text-[9px], scale caption at text-[9px]/[10px], legend rows at text-[10px] - below legible size
Scene error overlay offers no Retry; the only recovery is a full page reload
SceneView container has no accessible name and the drawing hint is not announced (pointer-events-none div, no aria-live)
Rail is vertically centred and the Profile button is conditionally inserted, so all rail buttons jump when a profile is built

strengths: Chart-to-scene hover linkage: moving over the profile drops a red marker at the exact sampled 3D point, with a deliberate shared 1 m Z offset so they line up (TerrainCrossSectionWorkspace.tsx:55-57, 137-160)
Honest DEM provenance: source-footprint pixel size is kept separate from Terrain3D sampling resolution instead of conflating them (terrainCrossSectionModel.ts:29-44, 176-195)
Adaptive sampling with no distance cap - long transects raise spacing instead of failing, and the Setup copy explains the ~1,800 sample budget (terrainCrossSectionModel.ts:85-101; Workspace:870-872)
Full-screen uses the Fullscreen API with a graceful fixed-inset fallback, body scroll lock and Esc handling (Workspace:162-221)
Clear state machine on the toolbar: one build button whose label tracks drawing/busy/rebuild state, and precise disabled rules (631-638)
Draft status pill tells the user the path length and next step before a profile exists (984-987)
Changing spacing or DEM mode in Setup auto-rebuilds the profile (858, 882)
Basemap for the 3D slice texture follows the main map's basemap id and effective scale so both render the same cartographic LOD (TerrainSlice3D.tsx:215-219, 241-253)
aria-pressed on all toggle buttons and role=alert on error toasts (673, 684, 1050, 997)

screens.name: Elevation analysis panel (Profile tab and 3D Terrain Slice tab)

roles: Same as the workspace: all OPERATIONAL_ROLE_NAMES (App.tsx:119-126); no in-panel gating
primaryTasks: Read elevation, distance and grade at any point along the path
Compare min/max/gain/loss and the DEM source resolution
Visualise the terrain corridor in 3D at a chosen width

painPoints.issue: Three stacked headings before any data (panel title, tab, card title) plus a 40-word provenance paragraph push the chart below the fold in a 360-720px panel
Tabs are plain buttons without role=tab/tablist/aria-selected
Slice presets are metre round numbers displayed in feet (164 ft, 328 ft, 820 ft, 1,640 ft) so they read as arbitrary
'Cut base' and the DEM-grid explanation are rendering internals shown as user data
metric prop is always false; the metric formatting branch and milesFromMeters are dead
Slice scene container div carries aria-label without a role, so the label is ignored by assistive tech

strengths: Control-point markers on the chart (dashed lines + P# labels) map exactly to map labels and slice labels (CrossSectionProfileChart.tsx:137-146; TerrainSlice3D.tsx:171-198)
Hover fields use aria-live=polite and tabular-nums; chart has role=img with a descriptive aria-label (ProfileChart:82, 104-106)
Chart colours use theme tokens (var(--brand), var(--bad), var(--line)) so it adapts to Light/Dark/Coastal (ProfileChart:110-158)
Request-id guards prevent stale slice/texture responses from overwriting newer ones (TerrainSlice3D.tsx:291-320, 461-516)
Texture failure degrades to a bare DEM with an explicit amber banner instead of a blank scene (TerrainSlice3D.tsx:418-420, 432-436)

crossCutting: Vocabulary drift for one concept: 'DEM coverage' (toolbar 678), 'DEM source coverage' (legend 955), 'Source coverage' (metric 764), 'Source footprint' (773), 'Source footprint resolution' (899) - five labels for the Esri PixelSize footprint value.

Esri-internal terms ('Terrain3D', 'Data Extents', 'PixelSize', 'finest-contiguous', 'World Elevation') appear in user-facing copy in 12+ places across TerrainCrossSectionWorkspace.tsx (77-95, 586, 769-776, 813-817, 876-908, 932, 968); the honest provenance story could be one sentence plus a disclosure.

'Project' (capitalised, CrossSectionSaveDialog.tsx:135-153) is a terrain-only entity while the rest of the app renamed Projects to Event Groups (App.tsx:77-78, AppShell.tsx:85); users will assume they are the same thing.

Four near-identical label/value tiles: DrawerMetric (Workspace:1058-1065), SliceStat (TerrainSlice3D.tsx:638-645), HoverField (CrossSectionProfileChart.tsx:167-174), Metric (CrossSectionSaveDialog.tsx:193-195) - one design-system Stat component would replace them.

Two haversine implementations: distanceMeters in terrainCrossSectionModel.ts:58-69 and again in AerialCaptureDialog.tsx:32-45; two niceFloor helpers (AerialCaptureDialog.tsx:47-53, sceneScaleBarModel.ts:15-22); FEET_PER_METER constant duplicated (AerialCaptureDialog.tsx:16, sceneScaleBarModel.ts:13, terrainCrossSectionModel.ts:266).

Dead / unused code: getSavedCrossSection and listProjectCrossSections (api/terrainCrossSections.ts:84-92) have no UI; milesFromMeters and every metric=true branch (terrainCrossSectionModel.ts:269-282) are unreachable because TerrainSlice3D is always called with metric={false} (Workspace:798); SceneDualScaleBar computes a metric line it never renders (sceneScaleBarModel.ts:39-43, SceneDualScaleBar.tsx:10); the 'Dual' name is misleading.

Button style inconsistency: five treatments in one toolbar (Workspace:606-662); selected-state chips use border-brand + color-mix in TerrainSlice3D/Aerial/Setup but bg-white text-slate-900 on the rail and DEM toggle (675, 1051); Close is × (h-8 w-8) in two places and a text 'Close' in the Save dialog (137).

Modal accessibility gaps repeat in both dialogs: no focus trap, no Escape close, no backdrop close; the Save dialog lacks aria-labelledby; inputs rely on placeholders or unassociated <label>s (CrossSectionSaveDialog.tsx:130, 158-160, 171, 175; AerialCaptureDialog.tsx:426-432).

Theme handling is split: overlays on the map are hard-coded slate/white (Workspace:594, 601, 705, 940, 954, 997), the aside and dialogs use --panel/--ink tokens, and the Save-dialog error uses light-only red-50 (CrossSectionSaveDialog.tsx:169) - Dark and Coastal themes get three different treatments on one screen.

No responsive strategy in the workspace: zero Tailwind breakpoints in TerrainCrossSectionWorkspace.tsx; every dimension is absolute/calc(), so the toolbar collapses below ~1360px and the panels overlay the map on tablets. The AppShell's min-h-screen/lg:h-screen split also means the map does not fill the viewport below lg (AppShell.tsx:138).

Touch: SceneView click-to-place works with tap, but crosshair cursor, title tooltips, chart hover readout and the 'Scroll to zoom' slice hint are hover/mouse-only (Workspace:420, 663, 676, 686; ProfileChart:107; TerrainSlice3D:439); all controls are 28-32px tall.

Repeated tiny type: text-[9px] and text-[10px] used for legend, scale bar, tile labels and hints (Workspace:958, 967, 991, 1061; SceneDualScaleBar.tsx:9, 19; ProfileChart:170) - below the 11px minimum used elsewhere in the app.

State is purely in-memory: no URL params, localStorage or saved-section loader, so refresh, navigation or a mis-click on New loses the work; the 'Save' feature therefore provides write-only persistence from this screen.
